title: Big Globe x Swampier Swamps
description: Adds the features, structures, and mobs from Swampier Swamps to Big Globe swamp biomes.
body: Adds the features, structures, and mobs of Swampier Swamps to Big Globe worlds. Requires both [Swampier Swamps](https://modrinth.com/mod/swampier-swamps/versions) and [Big Globe](https://modrinth.com/mod/big-globe).
